description:
About the Scholarship

LASCALA trains physicists in large-scale accelerator and laser technologies, including the facilities that power research at institutes like CERN and ELI. The class of 2027-2029 campaign opened on 2 November 2026, with the scholarship deadline on 17 February 2027 and a self-financed window to 30 April 2027.

OpportunityLASCALA – Erasmus Mundus Master in Large-Scale Accelerators and Lasers
HostLASCALA Consortium
LocationParis-Saclay (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students:
Application Deadline17 February 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

LASCALA trains physicists in large-scale accelerator and laser technologies, including the facilities that power research at institutes like CERN and ELI. The class of 2027-2029 campaign opened on 2 November 2026, with the scholarship deadline on 17 February 2027 and a self-financed window to 30 April 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Access to large research infrastructures through consortium and associated partners
  • Scholarship deadline 17 February 2027; self-financed until 30 April 2027
  • Physics-led curriculum with hands-on accelerator and laser-lab training
  • Graduates move into big-science facilities, photonics industry and doctoral programmes

Who Should Apply

Physics and engineering physics graduates with strong electromagnetism, optics and instrumentation basics are the intended audience.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance and travel support.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the LASCALA portal after 2 November 2026 and target the 17 February 2027 scholarship deadline. Key deadline information: 17 February 2027 (scholarship round); self-financed applications until 30 April 2027; campaign opened 2 November 2026.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About LASCALA Consortium

The LASCALA consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Large-Scale Accelerators and Lasers with European universities and research infrastructures in photonics and accelerator science.

Official website: https://www.master-lascala.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 17 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
